functions.name: connections_list
functions.description: Which connections this client was granted. An empty list is a real answer.

functions.name: omatic_guide
functions.description: Documentation this server hands out about itself. topic='operating' (default) is the operating guide: the full tool list, how to start a factory, how retrieval is governed, and what a refusal means. topic='architecture' is the architecture description in industry terms. topic='slate' is the slate.ops/1 operation set. Other topics: templates, project-headquarters, server-closet, upgrade, blueprint, blueprint-architecture, blueprint-acceptance-gate, blueprint-certification, blueprint-install-upgrade, blueprint-postgres, blueprint-components.

functions.name: search
functions.description: Semantic retrieval in ONE call: embeds the query on this host and searches the corpus. The vector never leaves the server. Searches CONTENT CHUNKS by default; pass tier='semantic' only for the entity router.

functions.name: task_relationships
functions.description: Which unfinished tasks are tied together, and which lanes each group touches. Links: 'cited' (names another by #number) and 'similar' (inferred). Pass task_id for that task's blast radius.

functions.name: task_duplicate_check
functions.description: CALL BEFORE INSERTING INTO factory.tasks. Embeds the draft task and returns closest existing tasks with similarity. verdict: likely_duplicate, related, or no_close_match. Names candidates; does not decide.

functions.name: slate_entity_search
functions.description: Search Factory systems of record a canvas element may be bound to: tasks, decisions, objectives and services, within the granted factory's tenant. Use returned id (e.g. task:509) as entity_id of a binding proposal.

functions.name: slate_entity_verify
functions.description: Confirm one entity still exists in its Factory system of record and return it with a verification stamp. Unresolvable id returns verified=false; nothing is invented.

functions.name: module_status
functions.description: Read-only. Reports add-on modules this server manages (installed, running, healthy, tier), which capabilities have a provider, and any module package discovery refused. Starts and changes nothing.
